## Type of change

- [ ] Fixing a bug
- [ ] Improving documentation
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Checklist for new profiles

- [ ] I added a single file at `contributors/<my-username>.json`.
- [ ] The file name matches the `username` field exactly.
- [ ] `username` uses lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
- [ ] `name` is filled in (required).
- [ ] `skills` has at most 10 items with no duplicates (if provided).
- [ ] I ran `npm run validate:contributors` locally and it passed.
